FreeToken requires torch>=2.11,<2.12; Common holds PyTorch 2.14.0, outside that range.

pydantic requires pydantic-core (Rust/maturin). meta-python supplies python3-pydantic-core 2.46.4 and it is BORROWED tonight so the API stack can build. But D2's rule is 'own what you ship, borrow what you only build with', and pydantic-core is linked into the shipped runtime, not merely used to build it. Under D2 it should be SyMoNeuRaL-owned, which means acquiring it as a source component. Recorded, not decided.

scipy requires a Fortran compiler. The OE cross toolchain is built LANGUAGES="c,c++" with FORTRAN="", so x86_64-oe-linux-gfortran does not exist. Evidence: scipy meson.build:91 'Unknown compiler(s): x86_64-oe-linux-gfortran', log tmp/work/x86-64-v3-oe-linux/symoneural-scipy/1.18.1/temp/log.do_compile.2878019. TOOLCHAIN decision, not a recipe fix: either rebuild gcc-cross with fortran enabled (FORTRAN:forcevariable = ",fortran"), or accept scipy/scikit-learn as unbuildable on this toolchain. Not resolvable by guessing.

8 licence-bearing files (OpenBLAS BSD-3, GotoBLAS, LAPACK modified-BSD, LAPACKE, ReLAPACK, netlib BLAS reference whose grant is non-OSI 'requests proper credit'). Recipe LICENSE expression is still the single token BSD-3-Clause. Retained UNRESOLVED.

resolved.blocks: R1 pristine-source guarantee for any externalsrc recipe with BBCLASSEXTEND
resolved.description: BBCLASSEXTEND = "native" on an externalsrc recipe gives the target and native variants the SAME EXTERNALSRC source tree, and bitbake schedules them concurrently. Isolated empirically: `bitbake -c compile -f symoneural-numpy-native` alone leaves the tree clean (mode 775), `-f symoneural-numpy` alone leaves it clean, but a full build that runs both flips numpy/_core/src/umath/loops_hyperbolic.dispatch.cpp.src from 100755 to 100644. Content is unchanged; the exec bit is lost because a writer rewrites the file. Options: drop BBCLASSEXTEND on externalsrc recipes, serialise the two, or give the native variant its own tree. Not resolved tonight.
resolved.resolution: RESOLVED by Phase 10b. symoneural-pristine.bbclass gives EVERY recipe variant its own disposable export (git archive HEAD -> ${WORKDIR}/pristine), so the target and native variants no longer share a tree. This is option 3 from the original description, applied universally rather than per recipe. Evidence: 41/41 acquired trees reported clean under `git status --porcelain --ignored=traditional` DURING a live build that scheduled both symoneural-numpy and symoneural-numpy-native; 0 dirty, 0 ignored residue. The negative test (tree moved off its pin) failed correctly with the PIN MISMATCH fatal.

resolved.description: No component demonstrated to compile with no network after bitbake -c fetch. Enumeration is not proof.
resolved.resolution: RESOLVED by Phase 5. symoneural-stratum: `--runall=fetch` rc=0, then `BB_NO_NETWORK=1 bitbake symoneural-stratum` -> do_compile Succeeded, 0 NetworkAccess denials, 102 rlibs produced, across rust 1.98.1 + LLVM 23 + 233 crate:// entries. Proof by execution, not by enumeration. (do_install failed separately on 'Did not find anything to install' - stratum is a library workspace with no bin targets; that is the open pydantic-core-class packaging question, not a network question.)
